outcome.query: restaurant careful about celiac disease and cross-contamination

results.name: Senza Gluten
results.address: Senza Gluten, 206 Sullivan St, New York, NY 10012

excerpts.text: Celiacs can eat without concern for cross contamination. Really good food for all!

… Nice one! As a celiac who struggles to eat in a safe place where people understand my disease it was ironic that I’ve never felt so unsupported than in this dedicated glutenless kitchen. I also have the signs of gluten poisoning the morning after. 👀 I would strongly recommend avoiding this place.

… However, in five days of NYC dining, our celiac friend did not have any problems with her celiac condition at any restaurant. There are many, many places to eat in NYC that can cater to severe celiac demands without fear of cross contamination and still offer a deliciously tasty meal. Sadly, this is not one of them.

results.name: Friedman's Herald Square
results.address: Friedman's Herald Square, 132 W 31st St, New York, NY 10001

excerpts.text: This place is incredible for people with celiac disease. Instead of having a gluten-free menu, their entire menu can be cooked with or without gluten. They are very careful about cross-contamination.

While many restaurants have gluten free items on their menus, most fail to recognize that celiac disease isn't a fad, and cross contamination is a real danger to those of us who have it. That's not an issue here. I've been here twice, and although it's a bit pricy on first glance, it's actually a bargain in reality. …
Great gluten free options. It's one of the few places that is consistently safe for those with Celiac Disease.

results.address: Cafe Eighty Two, 2282 Broadway, New York, NY 10024

excerpts.text: This dinner has a Gluten-free Card. On this card are breakfast dishes, lunch dishes and dinner dishes. The restaurant participates in the Gluten Free Awareness program for Celiac Disease. They are well aware of safe gluten-free preparation and look out for cross-contamination. We had breakfast here twice and both times we received generous portions. …
Extensive gluten free menu with a kitchen that knows how to keep celiacs happy. Awesome staff and all around great diner.
Happy and grateful for delicious gluten free menu! Both kids have celiac disease and we will definitely be back!

results.address: Friedman’s at Chelsea Market, 75 9th Ave, New York, NY 10011

excerpts.text: … This chain, in two separate locations had made me sick TWICE now. I am celiac and thought the first time was a fluke. After having gotten sick at another location, I want to warn people who look to this restaurant for safe, gluten free food. THIS CHAIN IS NOT CELIAC SAFE. You may be subjected to cross contamination!!! …

Very good meal. Lot of gluten free options, specified in the menu, and the waitress very helpful and willing to understand this concern. I really reccomend Steak ranchero. Amazing food, of course in a special place as Chelsea Market is.
Are you gluten-free? Then you simply must come here for brunch/lunch and try the Pastrami Hash or the Nova Bunny or the Fried Chicken.

results.address: Pappardella, 316 Columbus Ave, New York, NY 10023

excerpts.text: They have a huge gluten free menu, including pasta, panini and pizza. Would highly recommend this restaurant for people with celiac disease. The pizza containing gluten was also good. Great service. I'm only giving it four stars because of the somewhat old and worn interior.
Gluten-free pizza is fantastic !!! It looks pretty safe for celiacs. We had no problems!

We are with a person allergic to gluten which has severe reactions when eating something with cross-contamination of gluten, and in this place he was able to eat quietly and did not have any kind of reaction. In how much to the food very rich all but a little insipid.

results.address: Risotteria Melotti NYC, 309 E 5th St, New York, NY 10003

excerpts.text: … Even as California wine lovers, we were in love with the wine we enjoyed with our dinner. For anyone, literally anyone, you will enjoy this wonderful restaurant. For anyone with Celiac or gluten intolerance, you will LOVE this restaurant!

Wow! Loved this place. I have Celiac disease and everything is gluten free. So rare to find. I had the carbonara risotto and it was amazing. The ambiance was warm and inviting. For dessert I had the profiteroles and again was blown away. Great service as well. Will return.

Absolutely... Absolutely... Absolutely fantastic. Everything from the food to the wait staff was perfect. My wife has Celiac's, and this is a dream come true. Places like here are why I wish I lived in the city: full flavored gluten free food. Amazing.

results.name: Noglu
results.address: Noglu, 1266 Madison Ave, New York, NY 10128

excerpts.text: A strong contender for best gluten free brunch in NYC. This was my first time but I'll post more as I have a delightful time getting to know the menu. For someone with Celiac's disease this place is an oasis and a must visit while you are in NYC.

Awesome allergen friendly food. A great place for both celiacs and non-celiacs alike. The eclair and cream puff were out of this world. Sets the bar for gluten-free bakeries, not only in NYC but possibly in the US. I'm from Philly who has Sweet Freedom and blows it out of the water.

Small pastry shop in Manhattan totally gluten free. It has an upper lounge with 18 seats but which can only be used until 17:00. All very well done and tasty with several options of hot and cold drinks. We will be back more often for being safe for celiacs.
